senses.ms_definition: Kemungkinan nama keluarga asing, Brenner; rujukan token dalam paket ini belum dikenal pasti dan maknanya sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum disahkan.
senses.nuances: 此为暂定专名解释，noun 表示专有名词。下列组合用于展示专名的使用方式，不宣称为高频搭配；例句明确选用 Sydney Brenner，并不证明原始语料指的是他。可核实的人名实例见 [Nobel Prize 2002](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/2002/summary/)。由于缺少词典释义及语境，不能诚实标为 official。

etymology.historical_story: Foreign surnames can appear in Malay scientific writing without becoming Malay common words. Sydney Brenner provides a documented example: he shared the 2002 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. That establishes a possible proper-name interpretation, but neither identifies this packet's referent nor establishes its surname etymology. See [Nobel Prize 2002](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/medicine/2002/summary/).
